morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|color](stem) + feature: Chak-witz (red-pyramid), Ek-nahb (black-lake); the Woodland overlay yields -karhak' (deep-forest) compounds and the clan-totem houses.
morphology.patronymic_form: the ch'ib'al (lineage), here MATRILINEAL on the Woodland pattern - names bestowed by the clan-mother; aj- (he of) / ix- (she of); the k'uhul ajaw line traces its dynasty; calendar-day birth-names.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: vine-choked pyramids and abandoned longhouse-towns: 'the lost Witz of [ajaw]', 'the Ghost-Longhouse of [clan]'
patterns.military_units: the [k'uhul ajaw] Holkan / the [clan-totem] warriors: 'the Jaguar Holkan', 'the Wolf-clan warriors'
patterns.ships: river and forest-lake canoes: 'the Jade Canoe', 'the Quetzal of the Ha''
patterns.taverns: the plaza balche'-house and the longhouse: 'the Cacao House', 'the Great Longhouse'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (Mayan primary, from family_mesoamerican theonym_sets.mayan; Woodland variant, from family_north_american theonym_sets.woodland), never real Maya/Iroquois gods. Tikan seeds/shifts Lawful, Neutral, or Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The witz-pyramid and the forest-grove keep the rites; the Long Count and the clan-mothers' thanksgivings bind the year.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment) take dread epithets: when Lawful - Maraxus -> Marakab the War-Fire (Wd. Waraksonon); when Chaotic - Tulrius -> Tulax the Blinding, Aeternus -> Aj Ternaj the Far Tyrant.

holy_symbol_motifs.Ix Rialtaj: the moon-mother cradling maize over the longhouse
holy_symbol_motifs.Kayanab: a great forest-tree rooted in the green earth

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the K'uh-nah (god-house) atop the witz (pyramid) of [power], and the forest-grove of the clans: 'the K'uh-nah of Tulax', 'the grove of Tularonon'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified k'uhul ajaw ancestors (the uchben) and the honored clan-mothers, kept in the day-count and the clan-recital; honored at the pyramid-tomb and the forest-grove.

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Kayanab (Wd. Kayanonon) - the enduring earth and forest; Lawful power
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Marakab (Wd. Waraksonon) - the war-fire; Chaotic power
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Ix Rialtaj (Wd. Realwenne) - the mother, the clan-mother of the powers; Neutral-honored
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulax (Wd. Tularonon) - sun and right-order; Lawful power

religion.the_one: Aj Ternaj (< Aeternus; Woodland variant Aterhonon) - the One; revered as the supreme maker when Lawful, acknowledged but set aside when Neutral, reviled as the far tyrant when Chaotic

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (the war-fire Marakab, the blood-cult, the raid), demonize the Lawful powers and the One
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aj Ternaj) and the Lawful powers (Tulax, Orlanab, Numench, Kayanab), demonize the Chaotic powers (Marakab, Wakix, Lusankaan)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the uchben (ancestral dead), the day-lords, the clan-mothers' thanksgivings, and the local k'uh and forest-spirits

titles._tiers_note: Mayan backbone, ascending, on a Woodland clan-base. Batab' (local chief, seated by the clan-mother) barony; Nakom (war-captain) march; Sajal (subordinate governor) county; Ajaw (town-king) duchy; K'uhul Ajaw (holy lord) principality; Kalomte' (overlord) kingdom; Noh-Kalomte' (great overlord) empire. The matrilineal ohwachira-clans and their clan-mothers (the Woodland overlay) choose and may depose the batabs; the ah-k'in priests and the Long Count order the realm. (Native rank titles are the real Maya/Iroquois register, allowed; DISPLAY titles are English.)
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are plain ENGLISH - NO approved foreign term applies here (neither the Maya nor the Woodland ranks are on the approved commonly-known list), so there is no foreign display term and approved_foreign_terms_used is omitted. The *_native conlang forms (Mayan, with the Woodland clan-mother overlay) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

female_forms_native._clan_mother: the clan-mother (Woodland overlay) seats the batabs

titles.government: feudal (a jungle pyramid-kingship over matrilineal forest-clans: the k'uhul ajaw and the ajaw nobility, but the clan-mothers of the ohwachira-clans seat the local batabs - a Maya crown on a Woodland clan-base)
titles.heir: Baah-ch'ok (head-youth, the heir-apparent; named within the matrilineal clan)
